items.text_th: หมดเขตย้ายแอพไปVNG ไปแล้ว แต่เรายังไม่ได้ย้าย ทำยังไงได้บ้าง หรือทำอะไรไม่ได้แล้วคะ
items.text_vn: Hết hạn chuyển app sang VNG rồi mà mình vẫn chưa chuyển, làm sao được hay không làm được gì nữa ạ?
items.text_en: The deadline to move the app to VNG is over but I haven't moved yet. What can I do, or is it too late?
items.summary_vn: Hỏi cách làm khi lỡ hạn chuyển tài khoản sang VNG.
items.summary_en: Asks what to do after missing the VNG account transfer deadline.

items.text_th: น้องก็ยังน่ารักอยู่นะ ถึงหน้าตาน้องจะแก่
items.text_vn: Bé vẫn đáng yêu mà, dù mặt bé trông già
items.text_en: The little one is still cute even though it looks old.
items.summary_vn: Khen thú cưng vẫn dễ thương dù trông già.
items.summary_en: Says the pet is still cute even if it looks old.

items.text_th: ◌ัหมดเขตย้าย26 แล้วถ้าหลัง26คนที่มีบัญชีเก่าแต่ไม่รู้ข่าวว่าเขาให้ย้าย จะต้องทำยังไงหรอคะ
items.text_vn: Hết hạn chuyển ngày 26 rồi, nếu sau ngày 26 người có tài khoản cũ mà không biết tin được chuyển thì phải làm sao ạ?
items.text_en: The transfer deadline is the 26th. After that, what should people with old accounts who never heard about the transfer do?
items.summary_vn: Hỏi người có tài khoản cũ không biết tin phải làm gì sau hạn 26.
items.summary_en: Asks what players with old accounts who missed the news should do after the 26th.

items.text_th: ขอคำปรึกษาเรื่องการย้ายเซิร์ฟหน่อยค่ะ เราโหลดตัวเวอร์ชั่นเก่าเพื่อเอารหัสไม่ได้ค่ะ
items.text_vn: Xin tư vấn về việc chuyển máy chủ ạ. Mình không tải được phiên bản cũ để lấy mã.
items.text_en: I need advice about moving servers. I can't download the old version to get the code.
items.summary_vn: Không tải được bản cũ để lấy mã chuyển tài khoản.
items.summary_en: Can't download the old version to get the transfer code.

items.text_th: ท้อกับการหาไข่ไก่ ในดาวน์ทาว์น
items.text_vn: Nản với việc tìm trứng gà ở Downtown quá
items.text_en: I'm discouraged by how hard it is to find chicken eggs in Downtown.
items.summary_vn: Than khó tìm trứng gà cho nhiệm vụ sự kiện ở Downtown.
items.summary_en: Complains it is hard to find chicken eggs in Downtown for the event quest.

items.text_th: กระเทียมอยู่ในมาร์ทมั้ยคะ อยู่ตรงไหน หาไม่เจอ
items.text_vn: Tỏi có trong siêu thị (Mart) không ạ, ở chỗ nào, mình tìm không thấy
items.text_en: Is garlic sold in the Mart? Where is it? I can't find it.
items.summary_vn: Hỏi tỏi bán ở đâu trong Mart.
items.summary_en: Asks where to find garlic in the Mart.

items.text_th: ตอนนี้อีเว้นอะไรแล้วอะ ไม่มีเวลาเล่นเลย
items.text_vn: Bây giờ đang sự kiện gì rồi vậy, mình không có thời gian chơi luôn
items.text_en: What event is on now? I don't even have time to play.
items.summary_vn: Hỏi sự kiện hiện tại vì không có thời gian chơi.
items.summary_en: Asks what the current event is because they have no time to play.

items.text_th: เกมมันแสบนะปรับเรทดร็อปไข่ไก่ทุกที่เลยก่อนหน้ากิจมีเต็มไปหมดบวกกับคนวิ่งกันเก็บเยอะอีกจะเก็บถึง5ฝองตอนไหน
items.text_vn: Game 'cay' thật, chỉnh tỉ lệ rơi trứng gà ở mọi nơi; trước khi có nhiệm vụ thì đầy khắp nơi, giờ lại thêm nhiều người chạy đi nhặt, biết khi nào mới nhặt đủ 5 quả
items.text_en: The game is sneaky: it lowered the chicken egg drop rate everywhere. Before the quest they were all over the place, and now many people are running to collect them. When will I ever get 5 eggs?
items.summary_vn: Phàn nàn game giảm tỉ lệ rơi trứng gà nên khó nhặt đủ 5 quả.
items.summary_en: Complains the chicken egg drop rate was lowered, making 5 eggs hard to collect.

items.text_th: ขอสอบถามเพื่อน ๆ ในกลุ่มหน่อยค่ะ มีใครเคยเจอปัญหาแบบนี้บ้างไหมคะ คือเราจะกดสมัครสมาชิกพลัส ตอนแรกเลือกชำระผ่านพร้อมเพย์ แล้วกดรับดาวน์โหลดไว้เรียบร้อยแล้ว พอดีนึกขึ้นได้ว่ามีเงินอยู่ใน TrueMoney เลยตั้งใจว่าจะเปลี่ยนไปชำระผ่าน TrueMoney แทน แต่พอกดเข้าไปใหม่กลับขึ้นข้อความว่า “สินค้าอยู่ระหว่างดำเนินการ [9013]” เราก็เลยคิดว่าไม่เป็นไร งั้นกลับไปชำระผ่านพร้อมเพย์ก็ได้ แต่พอเข้าไปดูในแกลเลอรี กลับไม่มี QR Code ให้สแกนชำระเงินเลยค่ะ จนถึงวันนี้ลองเข้าไปใหม่ก็ยังขึ้นข้อความเดิมอยู่ ไม่รู้ว่าต้องแก้ไขยังไง หรือต้องรอให้ระบบยกเลิกคำสั่งซื้อเดิมก่อนหรือเปล่า ใครเคยเจอปัญหาแบบนี้ หรือพอจะมีวิธีแก้ไข แนะนำเราหน่อยนะคะ อยากสมัครสมาชิกแล้ววว
items.text_vn: Xin hỏi mọi người trong nhóm: có ai gặp vấn đề này chưa ạ? Mình bấm đăng ký thành viên Plus, ban đầu chọn thanh toán qua PromptPay và đã bấm nhận tải xuống xong. Sau đó nhớ ra có tiền trong TrueMoney nên định đổi sang thanh toán bằng TrueMoney, nhưng vào lại thì hiện thông báo “sản phẩm đang được xử lý [9013]”. Mình nghĩ không sao, quay lại thanh toán PromptPay vậy, nhưng vào thư viện ảnh thì không có mã QR để quét thanh toán. Đến hôm nay vào lại vẫn hiện thông báo cũ, không biết sửa thế nào hoặc có phải chờ hệ thống hủy đơn cũ không. Ai từng gặp hoặc biết cách sửa thì chỉ giúp mình nhé, mình muốn đăng ký thành viên lắm.
items.text_en: Has anyone had this problem? I tried to subscribe to Plus, first chose PromptPay and started the download. Then I remembered I had money in TrueMoney and wanted to switch, but it now says the item is being processed [9013]. I went back to PromptPay but there is no QR code in the gallery to scan. It still shows the same message today. How do I fix it, or do I need to wait for the old order to be cancelled? I really want to subscribe.
items.summary_vn: Đặt đơn Plus bị kẹt lỗi [9013], không có mã QR để thanh toán.
items.summary_en: Plus subscription order is stuck with error [9013], and no QR code to pay.
items.theme: Không nhận vật phẩm sau thanh toán

items.text_th: เริ่มทำกันยังคะ
items.text_vn: Mọi người bắt đầu làm chưa ạ?
items.text_en: Has everyone started yet?
items.summary_vn: Hỏi mọi người đã bắt đầu làm nhiệm vụ sự kiện chưa.
items.summary_en: Asks if others have started the event quest.

items.text_th: จะกลับมาเล่นจะย้าย แต่อันเก่าไม่ยอมโหลดเข้าให้จะไปเอาโค้ดต้องทำยังไงคะ
items.text_vn: Mình định quay lại chơi và chuyển tài khoản, nhưng bản cũ không chịu tải vào để lấy mã, phải làm sao ạ?
items.text_en: I want to come back and transfer, but the old version won't load so I can get the code. What should I do?
items.summary_vn: Người chơi quay lại không vào được bản cũ để lấy mã chuyển.
items.summary_en: A returning player can't load the old version to get the transfer code.

items.text_th: ทำผัดไทยตรงไหนเหรอคะ
items.text_vn: Làm món pad thai ở đâu vậy ạ?
items.text_en: Where do I make the pad thai?
items.summary_vn: Hỏi chỗ làm pad thai trong nhiệm vụ sự kiện.
items.summary_en: Asks where to make pad thai in the event quest.

items.text_th: ไปเดินซื้อของกิจกรรมรถตุ๊กตุ๊กวันที่สองกันเถอะ (มาช้าหน่อยเดินเก็บไข่อยู่ )
items.text_vn: Cùng đi mua đồ cho sự kiện xe tuk tuk ngày thứ hai nhé (hơi muộn, mình đang đi nhặt trứng)
items.text_en: Let's go shopping for the tuk tuk event, day two (a bit late, I was out collecting eggs).
items.summary_vn: Chia sẻ đi mua đồ sự kiện xe tuk tuk ngày hai.
items.summary_en: Shares shopping for the tuk tuk event on day two.

items.text_th: น้องมานานยังคะ แล้วจะอยู่ตลอดมั้ยTT
items.text_vn: Bé (thú cưng) có đến lâu chưa ạ, và bé sẽ ở lại luôn chứ? huhu
items.text_en: Has the little one been here a long time, and will it stay forever? T_T
items.summary_vn: Hỏi thú cưng sự kiện có ở lại lâu dài không.
items.summary_en: Asks whether the event pet will stay permanently.
items.theme: Hoạt động và tính năng trong game
items.topic: Activities (fishing, bugs, pets, housing, jobs, minigames)

items.text_th: หาวิธีทำกิจฮาโลวีนกับโรงเเรมหน่อยค่ะเพิ่งกลับมาเล่น
items.text_vn: Cho mình hỏi cách làm nhiệm vụ Halloween và khách sạn với ạ, mình mới quay lại chơi
items.text_en: Please tell me how to do the Halloween and hotel quests. I just came back to the game.
items.summary_vn: Người chơi quay lại hỏi cách làm nhiệm vụ Halloween và khách sạn.
items.summary_en: A returning player asks how to do the Halloween and hotel quests.

items.text_th: จดหมายส้มผมหายอ่ะ ยังทำเควสรถตุ๊กตุ๊กของวันนี้ไม่เสร็จเลย มันทำย้อนหลังได้ปะครับ
items.text_vn: Thư cam của mình biến mất rồi, hôm nay chưa làm xong nhiệm vụ xe tuk tuk, có làm bù được không ạ?
items.text_en: My orange letter disappeared and I haven't finished today's tuk tuk quest. Can I do it later?
items.summary_vn: Thư cam biến mất, hỏi có làm bù nhiệm vụ tuk tuk được không.
items.summary_en: Orange letter vanished; asks if the tuk tuk quest can be done later.

items.text_th: ทำใจค่ะ
items.text_vn: Chấp nhận thôi ạ
items.text_en: Just accept it.
items.summary_vn: Khuyên chấp nhận việc lỡ hạn chuyển.
items.summary_en: Advises accepting that the transfer deadline was missed.

items.text_th: ทำใจอย่างเดียว เกมประกาศให้ย้ายๆ มาหลายเดือนแล้ว แถมยังต่อเวลาให้อีก เอาของรางวัลมาล่ออีก ทุกวิถีทางละ ถ้าพลาดกันคงไม่ใช่ปห.ของเกมแล้วล่ะ
items.text_vn: Chỉ có thể chấp nhận thôi. Game thông báo cho chuyển mấy tháng rồi, còn gia hạn thêm, lại dùng phần thưởng để dụ, đủ mọi cách rồi. Nếu vẫn lỡ thì chắc không phải lỗi của game nữa.
items.text_en: Just accept it. The game has announced the transfer for months, extended the deadline and even offered rewards. If people still missed it, it isn't the game's problem.
items.summary_vn: Cho rằng game đã thông báo nhiều tháng nên lỡ hạn không phải lỗi game.
items.summary_en: Says the game announced the transfer for months, so missing it isn't the game's fault.

items.text_th: เกมแจ้งมาหลายเดือนแล้วค่ะ ถ้าคนที่เค้าไม่รู้ข่าวแปลว่าตลอดหลายเดือนเค้าไม่เข้ามาเล่นเลย เค้าคงหมดไฟไม่เล่นกันแล้ว
items.text_vn: Game đã thông báo mấy tháng rồi ạ. Ai không biết tin nghĩa là suốt mấy tháng đó họ không vào chơi, chắc họ hết hứng không chơi nữa rồi.
items.text_en: The game announced it months ago. Anyone who didn't know hasn't played for months and probably lost interest.
items.summary_vn: Cho rằng người không biết tin chuyển tài khoản đã bỏ game từ lâu.
items.summary_en: Thinks players who missed the transfer news had already quit.

items.text_th: ผมแนะนำไปเติมที่เว็ปนะครับ เป็นของทางเกมเลยครับ
items.text_vn: Mình khuyên nạp trên web ạ, là web chính thức của game
items.text_en: I suggest topping up on the website; it's the game's official site.
items.summary_vn: Khuyên nạp tiền qua web chính thức.
items.summary_en: Suggests topping up through the official website.
items.theme: Không nhận vật phẩm sau thanh toán

items.text_th: กดยกเลิกคำสั่งซื้อใน app store ครับ
items.text_vn: Bấm hủy đơn hàng trong App Store ạ
items.text_en: Cancel the order in the App Store.
items.summary_vn: Khuyên hủy đơn hàng trong App Store.
items.summary_en: Advises cancelling the order in the App Store.
items.theme: Không nhận vật phẩm sau thanh toán

items.text_th: ไอตัวบนจับยากมาก
items.text_vn: Con ở trên bắt khó lắm
items.text_en: The one on top is really hard to catch.
items.summary_vn: Nhận xét con ở trên rất khó bắt.
items.summary_en: Says the one on top is very hard to catch.
items.theme: Hoạt động và tính năng trong game
items.topic: Activities (fishing, bugs, pets, housing, jobs, minigames)

items.text_th: เก่งมากก
items.text_vn: Giỏi quá
items.text_en: So good!
items.summary_vn: Khen người đăng giỏi.
items.summary_en: Praises the poster.

items.text_th: เหมือนว่าหมดเวลาแล้วนะครับ ย้ายไม่ได้แล้ว
items.text_vn: Hình như hết thời gian rồi ạ, không chuyển được nữa
items.text_en: It seems time is up; you can't transfer anymore.
items.summary_vn: Trả lời hết thời gian, không chuyển được nữa.
items.summary_en: Says time is up and transferring is no longer possible.

items.text_th: ขออนุญาตDMถามได้ไหมคะว่าทำยังไง
items.text_vn: Cho mình xin phép nhắn tin riêng hỏi cách làm được không ạ?
items.text_en: May I DM you to ask how to do it?
items.summary_vn: Xin nhắn tin riêng để hỏi cách chuyển.
items.summary_en: Asks to DM to learn how to transfer.

items.text_th: ขออนุญาตทักไปถามได้ไหมคะ
items.text_vn: Cho mình xin phép nhắn hỏi được không ạ?
items.text_en: May I message you to ask?
items.summary_vn: Xin nhắn tin hỏi cách chuyển tài khoản.
items.summary_en: Asks to message to ask about the transfer.

items.text_th: ถ้าต้องการรหัส ทักมาได้ค่ะ เค้าเข้าไปเอาให้
items.text_vn: Nếu cần mã thì nhắn mình nhé, mình vào lấy giúp
items.text_en: If you need the code, message me and I'll go get it for you.
items.summary_vn: Đề nghị lấy giúp mã chuyển tài khoản.
items.summary_en: Offers to fetch the transfer code for the poster.

items.text_th: Dm ไปถามได้มั้ยคะ
items.text_vn: Nhắn tin riêng hỏi được không ạ?
items.text_en: Can I DM to ask?
items.summary_vn: Xin nhắn tin riêng để hỏi.
items.summary_en: Asks to DM with a question.

items.text_th: ที่ไหนด้ได้ครับไม่จำเปนต้องดาวทาว
items.text_vn: Ở đâu cũng được ạ, không nhất thiết phải ở Downtown
items.text_en: Anywhere works; it doesn't have to be Downtown.
items.summary_vn: Trả lời trứng gà nhặt ở đâu cũng được.
items.summary_en: Says eggs can be collected anywhere, not only Downtown.

items.text_th: ตอนยังไม่มีภาระกิจเห็นเพียบแทบอยากเดินเตะทิ้ง
items.text_vn: Lúc chưa có nhiệm vụ thì thấy đầy khắp nơi, suýt muốn đá bỏ
items.text_en: Before the quest there were tons of them; I almost wanted to kick them away.
items.summary_vn: Kể trước khi có nhiệm vụ trứng đầy khắp nơi.
items.summary_en: Says eggs were everywhere before the quest started.

items.text_th: เอาไปทำไรหรอคะ
items.text_vn: Mang đi làm gì vậy ạ?
items.text_en: What do you use them for?
items.summary_vn: Hỏi trứng dùng để làm gì.
items.summary_en: Asks what the eggs are used for.

items.text_th: ดาวทาวน์กับสวนไดโนเสาร์ก็มีนะคะ
items.text_vn: Downtown và vườn khủng long cũng có ạ
items.text_en: There are some in Downtown and the dinosaur park too.
items.summary_vn: Chỉ thêm chỗ có trứng ở Downtown và vườn khủng long.
items.summary_en: Points out Downtown and the dinosaur park also have eggs.

items.text_th: กระเทียมอยู่ตรงแตงกวาค่ะ
items.text_vn: Tỏi nằm chỗ dưa chuột ạ
items.text_en: Garlic is at the cucumber stall.
items.summary_vn: Trả lời tỏi nằm cạnh dưa chuột.
items.summary_en: Says garlic is next to the cucumbers.

items.text_th: ทำไมซื้อแล้ววัตถุดิบไม่ขึ้นคั
items.text_vn: Sao mua rồi mà nguyên liệu không hiện lên vậy?
items.text_en: Why don't the ingredients show up after I buy them?
items.summary_vn: Mua rồi mà nguyên liệu không hiện trong nhiệm vụ.
items.summary_en: Bought ingredients don't register in the quest.
items.theme: Không nhận vật phẩm sau thanh toán

items.text_th: ข้อสุดท้ายตอบอะไรครับ
items.text_vn: Câu cuối trả lời gì vậy ạ?
items.text_en: What's the answer to the last question?
items.summary_vn: Hỏi đáp án câu hỏi cuối của sự kiện.
items.summary_en: Asks for the answer to the event's last question.

items.text_th: ซื้อทุกอย่าง 3 รอบแล้ว ไม่ขึ้นเลย ฮอดด็อกเกิลก็ซื้อแล้ว ไม่ขึ้นอีก
items.text_vn: Mình mua mọi thứ 3 lượt rồi mà vẫn không hiện. Hot dog cũng mua rồi, vẫn không hiện.
items.text_en: I bought everything three times and it still doesn't register. I bought the hot dog too and it still doesn't show.
items.summary_vn: Mua nguyên liệu 3 lượt vẫn không được ghi nhận.
items.summary_en: Bought ingredients three times and none registered.
items.theme: Không nhận vật phẩm sau thanh toán

items.text_th: นี่รอทำวันท้ายๆเลยจบ มีเวลาอีกนาน
items.text_vn: Mình đợi làm vào những ngày cuối cho xong luôn, còn nhiều thời gian
items.text_en: I'm waiting until the last days to finish it; there's plenty of time.
items.summary_vn: Định làm nhiệm vụ vào những ngày cuối vì còn nhiều thời gian.
items.summary_en: Plans to do the quest in the last days since there is time.

items.text_th: เราไปวน ตปท ก็ได้มาครบนะ ประเทศละฟอง อาจต้องใช้เวลาหน่อยค่ะ
items.text_vn: Mình đi vòng các nước ngoài cũng nhặt đủ, mỗi nước một quả, có thể mất chút thời gian ạ
items.text_en: I went around the foreign countries and got them all, one egg per country. It may take a while.
items.summary_vn: Chia sẻ đi vòng các nước ngoài để nhặt đủ trứng.
items.summary_en: Shares that touring other countries gives one egg each.

items.text_th: เฝ้าจุดเดิมเด่วมันก็เกิด
items.text_vn: Canh ở chỗ cũ một lát nó sẽ xuất hiện
items.text_en: Wait at the same spot and it will spawn.
items.summary_vn: Khuyên canh một chỗ để trứng xuất hiện.
items.summary_en: Advises camping one spot until eggs spawn.

items.text_th: เก็บได้แค่ที่ทาวใช่ไหมคะ
items.text_vn: Chỉ nhặt được ở Town thôi đúng không ạ?
items.text_en: Can you only collect them in Town?
items.summary_vn: Hỏi chỉ nhặt trứng được ở Town hay không.
items.summary_en: Asks if eggs can only be collected in Town.

items.text_th: อัพเดทแอปเก่ายังค่ะเน็ตไม่ดีรึป่าวค่ะ
items.text_vn: Bạn đã cập nhật app cũ chưa ạ, hay mạng không tốt?
items.text_en: Did you update the old app? Or is your internet bad?
items.summary_vn: Hỏi đã cập nhật app cũ chưa hoặc do mạng yếu.
items.summary_en: Asks whether the old app was updated or the connection is bad.

items.text_th: ขอโทษนะคะ แป้งสาลีของวันที่ 1 ต้องหยิบตรงไหนคะ
items.text_vn: Xin lỗi ạ, bột mì của ngày 1 phải lấy ở đâu ạ?
items.text_en: Sorry, where do I pick up the wheat flour for day 1?
items.summary_vn: Hỏi lấy bột mì của ngày 1 ở đâu.
items.summary_en: Asks where to get the day 1 wheat flour.

items.text_th: ที่ไหนมีไข่ให้เก็บบ้างคะ
items.text_vn: Chỗ nào có trứng để nhặt vậy ạ?
items.text_en: Where can I find eggs to collect?
items.summary_vn: Hỏi chỗ có trứng để nhặt.
items.summary_en: Asks where eggs can be collected.

items.text_th: ของเราจดหมายส้มหายค่ะ
items.text_vn: Thư cam của mình bị mất ạ
items.text_en: My orange letter is missing too.
items.summary_vn: Báo thư cam bị mất.
items.summary_en: Reports the orange letter is missing.

items.text_th: เหมือนว่าจะอยู่ ถึง วันที่ 26 เดือนนี้
items.text_vn: Hình như sẽ ở đến ngày 26 tháng này
items.text_en: It seems to stay until the 26th of this month.
items.summary_vn: Trả lời thú cưng ở đến ngày 26.
items.summary_en: Says the pet stays until the 26th.
items.theme: Hoạt động và tính năng trong game
items.topic: Activities (fishing, bugs, pets, housing, jobs, minigames)

items.text_th: ไม่รู้ว่ามีขาย ต้องรีบจัดด
items.text_vn: Không biết là có bán, phải mau sắm thôi
items.text_en: I didn't know it was for sale; I need to get one quick.
items.summary_vn: Mới biết vật phẩm có bán nên muốn mua ngay.

items.text_vn: Trứng nở ra con nào vậy ạ?
items.text_en: Which one hatched from the egg?

items.text_vn: Ở trước cửa hàng thú cưng đúng không ạ?
items.text_en: In front of the pet shop, right?
items.summary_vn: Hỏi vị trí ở trước cửa hàng thú cưng.

items.text_th: halloween ตกปลาที่พลาซ่าครับมันจะเป็นวงแดงๆ ส่วนกิจโรงแรมก็เอาค้อนไปทุบพวกกระเป๋า
items.text_vn: Halloween thì câu cá ở Plaza ạ, sẽ có vòng tròn đỏ. Còn nhiệm vụ khách sạn thì dùng búa đập mấy cái túi
items.text_en: For Halloween, fish at the Plaza where there's a red circle. For the hotel quest, smash the bags with the hammer.
items.summary_vn: Hướng dẫn nhiệm vụ Halloween (câu cá ở Plaza) và khách sạn (đập túi).
items.summary_en: Explains the Halloween (fish at the Plaza) and hotel (smash bags) quests.

items.text_th: ลองกดปิดเกมแล้วเข้าใหม่ไหมคะ มันขึ้นอยู่นะ
items.text_vn: Thử tắt game rồi vào lại xem ạ, nó vẫn có đó mà
items.text_en: Try closing the game and reopening it; it's still there.
items.summary_vn: Khuyên thoát game vào lại để thấy thư cam.
items.summary_en: Suggests restarting the game to see the letter.

items.text_th: ออกเหม เข้าใหม่เด๋วก็มาครับ
items.text_vn: Thoát game vào lại là sẽ có ạ
items.text_en: Exit the game and re-enter; it will come back.
items.summary_vn: Khuyên thoát game vào lại.
items.summary_en: Advises exiting and re-entering the game.

items.text_th: ย้ายไม่ได้ทำไงดีมันให้เอารหัสที่ไม่เคยมีตัวละครคืออะไรหรอค่ะ
items.text_vn: Không chuyển được thì làm sao, nó bảo lấy mã mà mình chưa từng có nhân vật, vậy là gì ạ?
items.text_en: I can't transfer. It asks for a code but I never had a character, what does that mean?
items.summary_vn: Không chuyển được tài khoản vì yêu cầu mã dù chưa từng có nhân vật.
items.summary_en: Can't transfer: asked for a code though never had a character.
